programmes.d: The queen of comedy, Carol Burnett dishes on Hollywood High, reminisces about her family, and her early days on The Garry Moore Show. Bob Hope chats about politics.
Ed Sullivan presents performances by The Doors, Jefferson Airplane, Steppenwolf, Vanilla Fudge, and The Temptations.
On tonight's episode, Carol introduces the actors who dub her and Harvey's voices for Spanish language audiences, using a classic "Carol & Sis" sketch to demonstrate their talents.
Danny DeVito has to cut off his ponytail for a role, Richard Benjamin stops by and Johnny jokes about the NBC Christmas party.
Ken Berry is tonight's guest, taking part in a spoof of the films of figure skating actress Sonja Henie: "Love In An Avalanche," which makes way for a more tropically based production number.
The great actress and great beauty Raquel Welch chats about Presidents Reagan and Carter, her 2nd marriage, getting negative press, and how she imagines her life in the year 2000.
John Candy stops by with screen icon Maureen O'Hara. Plus, Jim Valvano appears and Johnny gives up smoking in the monologue.
National Spelling Bee Champion Jon Pennington joins Johnny on the couch and George Carlin does a routine about losing things.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Mamas and The Papas, Florence Henderson, Ed Ames, John Byner, and Topo Gigio.

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Beatles, Richard Pryor, Senor Wences, Joan Rivers, Erich Brenn, George Carlin, Topo Gigio, and Elvis Presley.
Screen star Peter O’Toole was Oscar nom’d 8 times! Never won. Finally bagged the golden statue for lifetime achievement. O’Toole discusses The Stunt Man. Comic Buddy Hackett brings some laughs.
Bubble the Hippo makes an appearance (!) with animal trainer Joan Embery. Competing with Bubbles for the cutest animal on the show are twin baby orangutans and a horned frog.
It's a comedy fan's heaven when Dom Deluise and Don Rickles head to the couch.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Bernadette Peters and Cass Elliot guest star in the latest 'As The Stomach Turns', and Lyle causes havoc and absurdity on a live television

programmes.t: The Best of The Ed Sullivan Show
programmes.d: Ed Sullivan presents The Byrds, Petula Clark, Rudy Schweitzer, Glenn Yarbrough, Barbara McNair, and Two Carmenas.
Ed Sullivan presents performances by Four Tops, The Jackson 5, Smokey Robinson & The Miracles, The Supremes, Stevie Wonder, and The Temptations.
Stand-up master Super Dave Osborne sends up President George Bush, VP Dan Quayle, and reggae music!
Hollywood legend Jimmy Stewart admits he would rather play the accordian in the movies than sing and dance. He’s joined by Tracy Austin, the youngest tennis player ever invited to Wimbledon.

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Guest stars Eileen Farrell, Marilyn Horne, and David Frost class up the joint as they join Carol and the gang for an operatic production of Cinderella
Father and daughter night! Comedian Richard Pryor accompanies his daughter, actress Rain Pryor. They chat about Rain’s boyfriend Tony, and Dad’s string of 5 – count ‘em 5 – wives!
Tough guy Jack Palance guest stars, playing off his screen persona in a gangster sketch. Meanwhile Carol and Roger encounter Chris' newest beau--an eccentric flower child--in "Carol & Sis."

programmes.t: The Best of the Carol Burnett Show
programmes.d: Old friends Garry Moore and Durward Kirby visit for the holidays, contributing to a fast and funny toy ad and a tongue-twisting courtroom sketch
Carol welcomes guest star Jim Nabors! Segments include: "V.I.P." interviews Shirley Dimple; Jim and Carol as accident-prone misfits in "The Ski Lodge"; and the debut of "Carol & Sis".
Oprah Winfrey opens up about growing up poor and feeling blessed about her surging income. She says the contents of one’s linen closet are the best indicator of having made it.
Christmas in Saudi Arabia? Bob Hope talks all about entertaining American troops who were there to prevent Iraq’s attempted takeover of Kuwait.
The incredible Rita Moreno guest stars, appearing in a sketch as a nurse to the accident-prone Carol. Also featured: Tim as a hapless officer attempting to dishonorably discharge sergeant Harvey.
Steve Lawrence and Carol Channing join Carol, Harvey, Vicki, and Lyle for a blockbuster tribute to the Academy Awards, with songs and sketches paying homage to great films and filmmakers.
Stand-up comic Bill Maher describes growing up half Jewish and half Catholic. Actor James Woods talks about his recent wedding at the Graystone Mansion in Beverly Hills.

programmes.t: The Best of the Dean Martin Show
programmes.d: Sketches and songs with Dean Martin and celebrity guests Bing Crosby, Rip Taylor, Richard Castellano, and Clair & McMahon.
Taking up the pen, Burt Reynolds discusses his work on his autobiography. He comments on his streak of box office flops. Burt warmly welcomes Eddy Edwards, Britain’s one-man Olympic Ski Jumping team.
Tonight's guest star is Steve Lawrence, who plays the brilliant Russian director of a play put on by the P.T.A., and a hitman employed by Carol to take out her husband, played by Harvey.
Actress Angie Dickinson, who’s made over 50 films, chats about New Year’s Eve parties, New Year’s resolutions, her first date and coping with depression.
